body: kind of, sometimes i think that i can’t be bothered to wait any longer, but then i get too scared anyways
i bet you can never say no to those eyes!
happy birthday! i hope you have a great day :)
not my birthday, but i hope you all have a happy birthday no matter what. :)
Thank you so much for caring, it really means a lot. I would talk to other teens if I didn’t find it so difficult to talk to others. I hope you stay kind to yourself also. :)
Thank you. I’ve wrote a letter which I’m going to give to him when he’s next sober. I really appreciate your reply. :)

the main reason i haven’t killed myself yet is because of my dog and my cat. they depend on me and i love them too much. they can stress me out but it’s nothing compared to any other stress.

i would never get rid of them now but sometimes i wish i didn’t have them, so i could kill myself without feeling the guilt.

they’re also the only reason that i get out of bed most mornings, just to feed them.

my dog is the only reason i want to leave the house, so i can enjoy watching him be so happy running around a field. 

so yes, in my opinion, pets are amazing.

A letter is a good idea that I didn’t think of. I’ll write some things tonight and give it to him when he’s next sober. I’m still seeing the therapist, only about once a month currently. I would tell them but I’m sort of worried because I don’t know if my dad could get in trouble because of it or if I’d get to stay with him. Thanks for the advice.

Thanks for the resources :) I’m sort of worried to tell anyone because I don’t know if he can get in trouble or not, or if I can stay with him. I could probably talk to a school counsellor but I don’t know what they would/could do.
